title: Climatic gaps in Peru's protected-area network: code, derived data and supplementary material
description: Code, derived data, figures and supplementary tables for the article 'Protected-area networks can represent climate worse than chance, and threatened-species plans toward 30×30 need climatic targets to close the gaps: evidence from Peru' (Perspectives in Ecology and Conservation, submitted). Regularized Mahalanobis distance from every pixel of continental and maritime Peru to the most similar protected climate (CHELSA V2.1, Bio-ORACLE v3.0), tests against 999 null networks that keep each area's size, shape, natural setting and ecoregion mix, the expansion effort curve and 223 potential sites, and species-led versus climate-led prioritization with prioritizr.
